source_snapshot.procedure: Generic setup says clear logs; open Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor reading and threshold are human readable and match specification.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES treats the four-zone range as one literal sensor and truncates fallback output; it omits zone membership/aggregation, fitted memory, threshold capabilities and two-view/spec mapping.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION requires four independent zones, topology, empty-zone semantics and complete read-only evidence.

old_problem: One literal range query could falsely cover four zones. The source lacked DIMM/channel/slot membership, zone sensor source/aggregation, population-dependent empty behavior, per-zone identity/capability/freshness and complete Dashboard/Server Health comparison.
disposition_reason: Resolve range notation into four stable zone records, bind each to fitted memory membership and its approved sensing/aggregation algorithm, and judge every zone independently across complete OOB, both UI views and Project SPEC. Empty or unsupported zones are N/A only when topology/capability documentation proves it. Exact topology and zone algorithms are execution inputs.
decision_basis: XLSX row 874, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, Script reference, manifest and historical record were directly reviewed.
A zone may be a controller-derived aggregate rather than one DIMM/TSOD/PMIC; membership and algorithm are part of the measurement identity.
Four zones require four independent evidence/verdict rows; one/partial/component telemetry cannot substitute.
ED-13 governs N/A proof, ED-15 requires per-zone criteria, ED-17 rejects clearing and ED-20 preserves all four zone identities.

test_case.test_name: Verify DIMM thermal zones 1-4 independently against memory topology, aggregation rules and both UI views
test_case.purpose: Verify each DIMM thermal zone 1 through 4 is correctly mapped to its fitted memory region and aggregation source, is human readable in Dashboard and Server Health, and has specification-compliant value, units, status, implemented thresholds/hysteresis and freshness under the recorded passive operating state.
required_package: Board/BMC/BIOS and fitted CPU-channel-DIMM-slot topology with zone1-zone4 membership
Per-zone sensing source/aggregation algorithm plus stable SDR/API/entity/UI identities
Per-zone units/scaling/tolerance, threshold capability/values/hysteresis, health, freshness and empty-zone rules
Recorded memory load/power/airflow/fan state and optional approved time-aligned component telemetry
Pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual method
test_case.test_command: Do not clear logs, stress memory, alter fans or write thresholds. Build the approved four-row zone-to-memory/aggregation matrix from fitted topology. Enumerate complete sensor inventory and resolve four stable records; do not query `TEMP_DIMM_ZONE1~4` literally. Review the Script before use. For each zone separately capture full identity, raw value, units, capability/threshold/hysteresis, status and timestamp plus matching Dashboard and Server Health rows. Compare with the zone specification, aggregation/source and recorded passive condition; treat empty/N/A only by approved population/capability rules. Stop on missing, duplicate, swapped, stale or divergent zones without automatic retry.
test_case.expected_result: All four topology-applicable zones have unique correct membership/aggregation identity and separate complete OOB/Dashboard/Server Health evidence matching per-zone specification and freshness/tolerance. Empty or unsupported zones are explicitly and authoritatively justified. No zone/component substitutes for another and no log, load, fan or threshold mutation occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the fitted topology/aggregation matrix and independent complete OOB/two-UI/spec agreement for every applicable zone with engineer verdict. Literal range output, one zone, individual DIMM telemetry or truncated inventory cannot pass. Missing/swapped/duplicate zone, unjustified N/A, stale/mismatched value or required threshold/status failure is FAIL. Missing topology/algorithm/spec/method is NOT READY, not Pending or PASS; dynamic thermal protection is not covered.
safety_gate: Do not execute range notation literally; retrieve four stable zone identities.
Do not equate zone aggregates with component readings absent an approved algorithm/membership map.
Do not add memory stress, airflow/fan changes or threshold writes.
N/A requires topology/capability/spec proof; missing required limits fail.
Do not truncate output, expose credentials or run an unreviewed Script; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Board/BMC/BIOS and fitted memory topology with approved zone membership/aggregation
Separate Dashboard and Server Health evidence for every zone
Per-zone spec plus passive load/power/airflow, tolerance/freshness and optional reference comparison
Empty/missing/duplicate/swapped/stale disposition and pinned Script/alternate-method evidence
No-clear/no-write/no-stress/no-retry proof, health and four-zone engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is expected. On topology, zone or aggregation ambiguity or unexpected health change, stop and preserve per-zone first evidence; use approved BMC/memory topology diagnostics without stress or settings changes. Isolate any mutating tool and restore only through the authorized owner.

source_conflict.reason: The tilde is unsafe as a literal operand but consistently denotes zones 1-4 for read-only validation; topology and aggregation are readiness inputs.

blocked.reason: Four-zone passive validation is clear and its topology/spec inputs are supplyable.
